name: Umber Hulk
traits: A 14-level aberration monster class. Starts Medium with 20-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., +2 Strength, +2 Constitution, and −2 Intelligence. Speaks Umber Hulk and is proficient with simple weapons.
Starts with two claws, a bite, and +3 natural armor. Claws add full Strength and the secondary bite adds half. Natural armor rises to +5 at 4th level and +7 at 7th.
Gains tremorsense at 4th level (10 ft.) and burrow 20 ft. at 5th. By the end of the progression, tremorsense locates creatures or objects touching the ground within 60 ft.

Confusing Gaze starts with a 5-ft. radius at 7th level, rising to 30 ft. at 13th. It applies confusion at caster level 8 on a failed Will save. DC equals 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Charisma modifier.
Becomes Large with 10-ft. reach at 9th level. At 14th level the class has 8d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 7.

name: Air Elemental
traits: A 14-level elemental monster class. Starts Small with +4 Dexterity and −4 Intelligence, fly speed 100 ft. (perfect), darkvision 60 ft., and Auran.
Immune to poison, sleep, paralysis, stunning, and critical hits. Starts with +3 natural armor, a slam that adds 1½ times Strength, and bonus Flyby Attack and Improved Initiative.
At 2nd level gains bonus Weapon Finesse (slam), Air Mastery, and Whirlwind. Airborne opponents take −1 on attack and damage rolls against the elemental.
Whirlwind uses the air elemental rules from the original Monster Manual. Damage equals the slam dice without Strength. The Reflex DC is 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier.
Becomes Medium at 4th level and Large with 10-ft. reach at 13th. Gets damage reduction 5/+1 at 9th. At 14th level the class has 8d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 5.

name: Imp
traits: A seven-level Tiny outsider monster class. Starts with +2 Dexterity, 20-ft. land speed, immunity to poison, and darkvision 60 ft. that works in magical darkness. Speaks Celestial, Draconic, and Infernal.

Starts with a venomous sting. At 2nd level gains bonus Weapon Finesse (sting) and at-will detect good and detect magic. The class spell-like abilities other than commune use twice the class Hit Dice as caster level.
At 3rd level gains flight, fire resistance 5, and one alternate form up to Medium, usable at will as polymorph self at caster level 12. Adds a second form at 6th.

At 4th level gains self-only invisibility at will and damage reduction 5/silver or holy. Higher tiers add regeneration, daily suggestion, weekly commune, and fast healing. At 7th level the class has 3d8 Hit Dice, ECL 7, and CR 2.
Sting applies Dexterity damage. Its Fortitude DC is 10 + half the class Hit Dice + Constitution modifier + 2. The table raises the dice as the class progresses.

name: Rakshasa
traits: A 14-level outsider monster class. Starts Medium with +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, 40-ft. land speed, darkvision 60 ft., two claws, and Common, Infernal, and Undercommon.

Alternate Form starts at 1/day for one hour, rises to 3/day for up to two hours at 4th level, and becomes at will at 8th. It uses the original alter self spell at caster level 18, limited to humanoid forms.

Gains a bite and spells at 2nd level. Casts as a sorcerer of level equal to the class Hit Dice and may learn 1st-level cleric spells as arcane spells. Detect thoughts starts at 3rd level and uses class level + 4 as caster level and DC 12 + Charisma modifier.
At 4th level gains immunity to 1st-level spell effects. Later levels raise the maximum spell level affected. May suppress immunity to accept spells. Later tiers also grant damage reduction.
Any hit from a blessed crossbow bolt instantly kills the rakshasa. At 14th level the class has 7d8 Hit Dice, ECL 14, and CR 8.
